{{nihongo|'''Amatsukasahiko Shrine'''|天都賀佐比古神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}{{ill|Mima, Tokushima|Q857828|qid=Q857828}}{{ill|Mimachō|Q11609479|qid=Q11609479}}. {{nihongo|'''Amatsukasahiko Shrine'''|天都賀佐比古神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

== History ==
The year of foundation is unknown, but it is thought to have been founded before the {{ill|6th century|Q8090|qid=Q8090}}. It is said to have enshrined a deity served by the residents and district officials of the Omura-go (gunri) area, which lay along the border of {{ill|Mima District, Tokushima|Q1156496|qid=Q1156496}} in the late {{ill|Kofun period|Q459939|qid=Q459939}}, to pacify wind-related disasters and pray for abundant harvests.

== Enshrined deities ==
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shina-nagatsuhiko no Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Shinatsuhiko|Q1073925|qid=Q1073925|lt=Shina-nagatsuhime no Mikoto}}

== Access ==
* About a 10-minute drive from “{{ill|Oshima Station|Q7106623|qid=Q7106623}}” on the {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|Q496531|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}} {{ill|Tokushima Line|Q899310|qid=Q899310}}.
